### ✨ Eminence in Shadow Mod Menu (v5.1.0)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **The Eminence in Shadow RPG** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Sets IsImmortal, maxes Physical/Magic DEF & keeps HP full
- **Always Full HP** — Continuously restores ally CurrentHealthPoint to MaxHP
- **Enable Defense Multiplier** — Scales player PhysicalDefense (+0x30) & MagicDefense (+0x38)
- **Defense Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Multiplier factor for player Physical & Magic Defense
- **One-Hit Kill (OHK)** — Instantly defeats enemies (Bravo Team) in a single hit
- **Enable Damage Multiplier** — Scales player PhysicalAttack (+0x18), MagicAttack (+0x20) & BreakAttack
- **Damage Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Multiplier factor applied to player Attack & DamageLimit
- **Zero Enemy Defense (0 DEF)** — Sets enemy PhysicalDefense (+0x30) & MagicDefense (+0x38) to 0
- **Weaken Enemy Attack (0 ATK)** — Sets enemy PhysicalAttack (+0x18) & MagicAttack (+0x20) to 0
- **Drain Enemy SP (0 SP/Ult)** — Keeps enemy SpecialPoint (+0x70/+0x74) at 0
- **Wipe Current Wave Enemies** — Calls BattleMatch.WipeEnemies() on the active wave
- **Infinite SP & Ultimate Anytime** — Maxes SpecialPoint (+0x70) & unlocks Special/Ultimate anytime
- **Game Speed Multiplier (1.0x - 5.0x)** — Accelerates Unity Time.timeScale & BattleLogicTimer
- **Unlock 120 FPS** — Forces Application.targetFrameRate to 120 FPS

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
